# Rules catalogue

<!-- Generated by docs/gen-rules.sh from `svgdog rules`. Do not edit: change the source and run docs/gen-rules.sh. -->

SVGDog ships 38 rules that check any SVG, whether or not SVGDog drew it. This page lists each rule with its default severity (the `docs` profile), whether `svgdog fix` can repair it, its thresholds and a failing and a passing example. Severities and thresholds can be changed in [`svgdog.toml`](configuration.md).

The autofix column is `none` (no fix), `safe` (applied by `svgdog fix`) or `unsafe` (applied only with `--unsafe`).

## Summary

| Group | Rule | Default severity | Autofix | Fails when |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| structure | `svg-root` | error | safe | The root is not &lt;svg> in the SVG namespace |

| structure | `unknown-attribute` | warning | none | An attribute is not valid on its element |
| structure | `duplicate-id` | error | unsafe | Two elements share an id |
| structure | `dangling-reference` | error | none | A url(#...), href or marker reference names no element |
| structure | `viewbox-missing` | error | safe | The root has no viewBox |
| structure | `invalid-path-data` | error | none | A path's d attribute does not parse |
| structure | `invalid-value` | error | none | A length, colour or transform does not parse, or a size is negative |
| structure | `unused-def` | info | safe | An item in &lt;defs> is never referenced |
| geometry | `text-overflow` | error | safe | Text is wider or taller than its container less padding |
| geometry | `text-overlap` | error | none | The boxes of two text runs intersect |
| geometry | `shape-overlap` | warning | none | Two sibling shapes overlap without one containing the other |
| geometry | `content-clipped` | error | safe | Content extends outside the viewBox |
| geometry | `excess-margin` | info | safe | Empty margin exceeds 15% of either dimension |
| geometry | `edge-detached` | error | safe | A connector ends more than 2 px from any shape edge |
| geometry | `edge-through-node` | warning | unsafe | A connector crosses a shape that is not its endpoint |
| geometry | `label-on-line` | warning | unsafe | A text box intersects a connector stroke |

## Structure rules

### `xml-well-formed`

Default severity **error**. Fails when: The file does not parse as XML. Autofix: None.

A file that is not well-formed XML renders nowhere. No other rule can run on it.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <rect width="10" height="10">
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect width="10" height="10"/>
</svg>
```

### `svg-root`

Default severity **error**. Fails when: The root is not &lt;svg> in the SVG namespace. Autofix: Safe: add the namespace.

Without xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" a standalone file is shown as raw XML, not as an image.

Fails:

```xml
<svg viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80"/>
</svg>
```

### `unknown-element`

Default severity **error**. Fails when: An element is not part of static SVG. Autofix: None.

Renderers skip elements they do not know, so the content silently disappears.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rectangle x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80"/>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80"/>
</svg>
```

### `unknown-attribute`

Default severity **warning**. Fails when: An attribute is not valid on its element. Autofix: None.

A misspelled attribute is ignored and the default applies, which is rarely what the author meant.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" widht="180" height="80"/>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80"/>
</svg>
```

### `duplicate-id`

Default severity **error**. Fails when: Two elements share an id. Autofix: Unsafe: rename the later one.

References resolve to the first match only, and targeted edits become ambiguous.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect id="a" x="10" y="10" width="80" height="80"/>
  <rect id="a" x="110" y="10" width="80" height="80"/>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect id="a" x="10" y="10" width="80" height="80"/>
  <rect id="b" x="110" y="10" width="80" height="80"/>
</svg>
```

### `dangling-reference`

Default severity **error**. Fails when: A url(#...), href or marker reference names no element. Autofix: None.

A missing gradient, marker or clip path leaves the element unpainted or unclipped.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80" fill="url(#grad)"/>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="grad"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#dbeafe"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#2563eb"/></linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80" fill="url(#grad)"/>
</svg>
```

### `viewbox-missing`

Default severity **error**. Fails when: The root has no viewBox. Autofix: Safe: compute from content.

Without a viewBox the drawing cannot scale to the page; it is cropped or shown at a fixed size.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80"/>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80"/>
</svg>
```

### `invalid-path-data`

Default severity **error**. Fails when: A path's d attribute does not parse. Autofix: None.

Renderers draw a path only up to the first error, so part of the shape goes missing.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <path d="M10 10 X 190 90" stroke="#1f2937" fill="none"/>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <path d="M10 10 L 190 90" stroke="#1f2937" fill="none"/>
</svg>
```

### `invalid-value`

Default severity **error**. Fails when: A length, colour or transform does not parse, or a size is negative. Autofix: None.

An invalid value disables the attribute, and a negative size disables the whole element.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="-180" height="80" fill="#12345"/>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80" fill="#123456"/>
</svg>
```

### `unused-def`

Default severity **info**. Fails when: An item in &lt;defs> is never referenced. Autofix: Safe: remove.

Unused definitions add bytes and noise to diffs.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="grad"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#dbeafe"/></linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80"/>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="grad"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#dbeafe"/></linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80" fill="url(#grad)"/>
</svg>
```

## Geometry rules

### `text-overflow`

Default severity **error**. Fails when: Text is wider or taller than its container less padding. Autofix: Safe: widen the container.

A label that spills out of its box is cut off or collides with its neighbours. The measured width includes a reserve for font substitution at the reader's end.

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `padding` | 8 | Horizontal space kept free on each side of the text, in viewBox units |
| `reserve` | 0.08 | Fraction added to the measured text width |

Set in `svgdog.toml`: `[rules] text-overflow = { padding = 8 }`.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="70" y="30" width="60" height="40" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1f2937"/>
  <text x="100" y="55" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14">Fulfilment queue</text>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="70" y="30" width="60" height="40" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1f2937"/>
  <text x="100" y="55" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14">API</text>
</svg>
```

### `text-overlap`

Default severity **error**. Fails when: The boxes of two text runs intersect. Autofix: None.

Overlapping labels are unreadable.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <text x="20" y="50" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14">Order API</text>
  <text x="50" y="54" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14">Orders DB</text>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <text x="20" y="40" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14">Order API</text>
  <text x="20" y="70" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14">Orders DB</text>
</svg>
```

### `shape-overlap`

Default severity **warning**. Fails when: Two sibling shapes overlap without one containing the other. Autofix: None.

Partly overlapping boxes usually mean a layout mistake. Full containment is treated as intentional nesting.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="20" y="20" width="90" height="40" fill="#dbeafe"/>
  <rect x="90" y="40" width="90" height="40" fill="#dbeafe"/>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="20" y="30" width="70" height="40" fill="#dbeafe"/>
  <rect x="110" y="30" width="70" height="40" fill="#dbeafe"/>
</svg>
```

### `content-clipped`

Default severity **error**. Fails when: Content extends outside the viewBox. Autofix: Safe: grow the viewBox.

Anything outside the viewBox is cut off when the image is embedded.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="150" y="30" width="80" height="40" fill="#dbeafe"/>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="100" y="30" width="80" height="40" fill="#dbeafe"/>
</svg>
```

### `excess-margin`

Default severity **info**. Fails when: Empty margin exceeds 15% of either dimension. Autofix: Safe: fit the viewBox.

Wide empty margins shrink the diagram on the page and make its text smaller than it needs to be.

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `max_ratio` | 0.15 | Largest margin allowed on one side, as a fraction of that dimension |

Set in `svgdog.toml`: `[rules] excess-margin = { max_ratio = 0.15 }`.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="40" height="30" fill="#dbeafe"/>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80" fill="#dbeafe"/>
</svg>
```

### `edge-detached`

Default severity **error**. Fails when: A connector ends more than 2 px from any shape edge. Autofix: Safe: snap to the nearest edge.

A connector that stops short of its node reads as a broken or unrelated line. An end that lies inside a filled shape counts as attached, and the reach of an arrowhead marker is added to the limit.

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `max_gap` | 2 | Largest distance allowed between a connector end and a shape edge |

Set in `svgdog.toml`: `[rules] edge-detached = { max_gap = 2 }`.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" refX="6" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M0 0L6 3L0 6z"/></marker>
  </defs>
  <rect x="10" y="30" width="50" height="40" fill="#dbeafe"/>
  <rect x="140" y="30" width="50" height="40" fill="#dbeafe"/>
  <line x1="60" y1="50" x2="115" y2="50" stroke="#1f2937" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" refX="6" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M0 0L6 3L0 6z"/></marker>
  </defs>
  <rect x="10" y="30" width="50" height="40" fill="#dbeafe"/>
  <rect x="140" y="30" width="50" height="40" fill="#dbeafe"/>
  <line x1="60" y1="50" x2="140" y2="50" stroke="#1f2937" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
</svg>
```

### `edge-through-node`

Default severity **warning**. Fails when: A connector crosses a shape that is not its endpoint. Autofix: Unsafe: reroute.

A line running through an unrelated node looks like two separate connections. Unstroked boxes that sit tightly behind a label are treated as part of the label, not as nodes. The fix redraws a path or polyline as an orthogonal route round the shapes in its way; a &lt;line> cannot bend, so it gets no fix.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" refX="6" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M0 0L6 3L0 6z"/></marker>
  </defs>
  <rect x="10" y="35" width="40" height="30" fill="#dbeafe"/>
  <rect x="80" y="35" width="40" height="30" fill="#dbeafe"/>
  <rect x="150" y="35" width="40" height="30" fill="#dbeafe"/>
  <path d="M50 50 L150 50" fill="none" stroke="#1f2937" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" refX="6" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M0 0L6 3L0 6z"/></marker>
  </defs>
  <rect x="10" y="35" width="40" height="30" fill="#dbeafe"/>
  <rect x="150" y="35" width="40" height="30" fill="#dbeafe"/>
  <path d="M50 50 L150 50" fill="none" stroke="#1f2937" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
</svg>
```

### `label-on-line`

Default severity **warning**. Fails when: A text box intersects a connector stroke. Autofix: Unsafe: move the label.

A line through a label strikes it out. A label on an opaque shape drawn over the line is not reported.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" refX="6" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M0 0L6 3L0 6z"/></marker>
  </defs>
  <rect x="10" y="35" width="40" height="30" fill="#dbeafe"/>
  <rect x="150" y="35" width="40" height="30" fill="#dbeafe"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="50" x2="150" y2="50" stroke="#1f2937" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  <text x="100" y="54" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12">publish</text>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" refX="6" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M0 0L6 3L0 6z"/></marker>
  </defs>
  <rect x="10" y="35" width="40" height="30" fill="#dbeafe"/>
  <rect x="150" y="35" width="40" height="30" fill="#dbeafe"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="50" x2="150" y2="50" stroke="#1f2937" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  <text x="100" y="40" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12">publish</text>
</svg>
```

### `font-too-small`

Default severity **error**. Fails when: Text renders under 9 px at the target width. Autofix: Unsafe: raise the size.

The size is measured after scaling the viewBox to [target] render_width, which is what the reader sees.

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `min_px` | 9 | Smallest rendered font size, in px at the target width |

Set in `svgdog.toml`: `[rules] font-too-small = { min_px = 9 }`.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 720 200">
  <title>Example</title>
  <text x="20" y="100" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="7">At-least-once delivery</text>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 720 200">
  <title>Example</title>
  <text x="20" y="100" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14">At-least-once delivery</text>
</svg>
```

### `stroke-too-thin`

Default severity **warning**. Fails when: A stroke renders under 0.75 px at the target width. Autofix: Safe: raise to the minimum.

Hairlines vanish in print and on low-density screens.

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `min_px` | 0.75 | Thinnest rendered stroke, in px at the target width |

Set in `svgdog.toml`: `[rules] stroke-too-thin = { min_px = 0.75 }`.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 720 200">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="20" y="20" width="680" height="160" fill="none" stroke="#1f2937" stroke-width="0.4"/>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 720 200">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="20" y="20" width="680" height="160" fill="none" stroke="#1f2937" stroke-width="1"/>
</svg>
```

### `tight-spacing`

Default severity **info**. Fails when: The gap between sibling shapes is under 8 px. Autofix: None.

Shapes that nearly touch read as one block. Shapes that touch exactly are treated as intentionally joined.

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `min_gap` | 8 | Smallest gap between sibling shapes, in viewBox units |

Set in `svgdog.toml`: `[rules] tight-spacing = { min_gap = 8 }`.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="20" y="30" width="78" height="40" fill="#dbeafe"/>
  <rect x="102" y="30" width="78" height="40" fill="#dbeafe"/>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="20" y="30" width="70" height="40" fill="#dbeafe"/>
  <rect x="110" y="30" width="70" height="40" fill="#dbeafe"/>
</svg>
```

### `off-grid`

Default severity **info**. Fails when: A coordinate is off the configured grid. Autofix: Safe: snap.

Coordinates on a common grid keep edges aligned. The rule runs only when [style] grid is set.

The examples assume this `svgdog.toml`:

```toml
[style]
grid = 8
```

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="13" y="16" width="64" height="32" fill="#dbeafe"/>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="16" y="16" width="64" height="32" fill="#dbeafe"/>
</svg>
```

## Portability rules

### `script-content`

Default severity **error**. Fails when: The file has &lt;script>, event-handler attributes or javascript: URLs. Autofix: Safe: remove.

Scripts do not run when an SVG is embedded as an image, and sanitisers reject files that carry them.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80" onclick="go()"/>
  <script>function go() {}</script>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80"/>
</svg>
```

### `external-resource`

Default severity **error**. Fails when: An image, font, stylesheet or &lt;use> points outside the file. Autofix: None.

External resources are not loaded when an SVG is embedded as an image, and they break offline builds.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <image href="https://example.com/logo.png" x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80"/>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80"/>
</svg>
```

### `foreign-object`

Default severity **error**. Fails when: The file uses &lt;foreignObject>, which many PDF and image pipelines drop. Autofix: None.

HTML inside &lt;foreignObject> needs a browser. Converters to PDF or PNG leave the area blank, so labels vanish.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <foreignObject x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80"><div xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">Order API</div></foreignObject>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <text x="20" y="50" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14">Order API</text>
</svg>
```

### `animation`

Default severity **warning**. Fails when: The file has SMIL or CSS animation. Autofix: Safe: remove.

Animation does not survive PDF or raster output, and the frozen frame may not be the intended one.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="40" height="80"><animate attributeName="x" from="10" to="150" dur="2s"/></rect>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="40" height="80"/>
</svg>
```

### `font-not-portable`

Default severity **warning**. Fails when: A font-family has no generic fallback. Autofix: Safe: append one.

When the named font is missing, the renderer picks its own default, often a serif with different widths.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <text x="20" y="50" font-family="Helvetica Neue" font-size="14">Order API</text>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <text x="20" y="50" font-family="Helvetica Neue, sans-serif" font-size="14">Order API</text>
</svg>
```

### `css-unsupported`

Default severity **warning**. Fails when: Styles use custom properties, media queries or blend modes. Autofix: None.

Static renderers and PDF toolchains ignore these features, so colours fall back to black.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <style>.box { fill: var(--accent, #2563eb); }</style>
  <rect class="box" x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80"/>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80" fill="#2563eb"/>
</svg>
```

### `fixed-size`

Default severity **warning**. Fails when: The root sets absolute width and height, so it cannot scale to the page. Autofix: Safe: remove them.

With a viewBox and no fixed size, the image fills the width its page gives it.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100" width="200" height="100">
  <title>Example</title>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80"/>
</svg>
```

### `file-too-large`

Default severity **warning**. Fails when: The file exceeds 200 kB. Autofix: None.

Large diagrams slow pages and reviews. The examples assume a 0.1 kB limit so that they fit here.

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `max_kb` | 200 | Largest file size in kB (1000 bytes) |

Set in `svgdog.toml`: `[rules] file-too-large = { max_kb = 200 }`.

The examples assume this `svgdog.toml`:

```toml
[rules]
file-too-large = { max_kb = 0.1 }
```

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80"/>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 9 9"><title>T</title></svg>
```

### `embedded-raster`

Default severity **info**. Fails when: The file embeds a base64 raster image. Autofix: None.

Embedded bitmaps do not scale, cannot be diffed and usually dominate the file size.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <image href="data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgo=" x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80"/>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80"/>
</svg>
```

### `editor-metadata`

Default severity **info**. Fails when: The file holds editor namespaces, generator comments or timestamps. Autofix: Safe: strip.

Editor data changes on every save, which makes diffs noisy and output non-deterministic.

Fails:

```xml
<!-- Created with Inkscape (http://www.inkscape.org/) -->
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:inkscape="http://www.inkscape.org/namespaces/inkscape" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80" inkscape:label="box"/>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80"/>
</svg>
```

## Accessibility rules

### `title-missing`

Default severity **error**. Fails when: The root has no &lt;title>. Autofix: None; it needs words.

The title is the image's accessible name. Screen readers announce it in place of the drawing.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80"/>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80"/>
</svg>
```

### `desc-missing`

Default severity **warning**. Fails when: The root has no &lt;desc>. Autofix: None; it needs words.

The description tells a reader who cannot see the diagram what it shows.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80"/>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <desc>How an order moves from the storefront to fulfilment.</desc>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80"/>
</svg>
```

### `low-contrast`

Default severity **error**. Fails when: Text contrast against its background is under 4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text. Autofix: Unsafe: nearest palette colour that passes.

The background is the topmost filled shape under the text, or the first page background in [target] backgrounds when the text sits on the bare canvas. Large text is 24 px, or 18.66 px bold, at the target width.

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `min_ratio` | 4.5 | Smallest contrast ratio for normal text |
| `min_ratio_large` | 3 | Smallest contrast ratio for large text |

Set in `svgdog.toml`: `[rules] low-contrast = { min_ratio = 4.5 }`.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <text x="30" y="55" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#cccccc">Order API</text>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <text x="30" y="55" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#1f2937">Order API</text>
</svg>
```

### `background-missing`

Default severity **warning**. Fails when: Dark content sits on a transparent background, unreadable on a dark page. Autofix: Safe: add a theme background.

Documentation sites switch to dark pages; text and lines drawn straight on a transparent canvas disappear there. The rule runs when [target] backgrounds includes a dark page.

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `min_ratio` | 3 | Smallest contrast ratio against the dark page for content on the bare canvas |

Set in `svgdog.toml`: `[rules] background-missing = { min_ratio = 3 }`.

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <text x="30" y="55" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#1f2937">Order API</text>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="200" height="100" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <text x="30" y="55" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#1f2937">Order API</text>
</svg>
```

### `palette`

Default severity **warning**. Fails when: A fill or stroke is not in the configured palette. Autofix: Unsafe: nearest palette colour.

One palette keeps a documentation set consistent. The rule runs only when [style] palette is set.

The examples assume this `svgdog.toml`:

```toml
[style]
palette = ["#1f2937", "#ffffff"]
```

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80" fill="#ff0000" stroke="#1f2937"/>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1f2937"/>
</svg>
```

### `stroke-width-style`

Default severity **info**. Fails when: A stroke width is not in the configured set. Autofix: Safe: nearest allowed width.

A small set of line weights keeps diagrams visually consistent. The rule runs only when [style] stroke_widths is set.

The examples assume this `svgdog.toml`:

```toml
[style]
stroke_widths = [1, 2]
```

Fails:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1f2937" stroke-width="1.3"/>
</svg>
```

Passes:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 100">
  <title>Example</title>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="180" height="80" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1f2937" stroke-width="1"/>
</svg>
```

## Suppression diagnostics

A malformed `svgdog-disable` comment is reported as `invalid-suppression` (always an error). It is not part of the catalogue above and cannot itself be configured or suppressed. See [Configuration](configuration.md#suppressing-a-rule-on-one-element).
